Snapshot `d4d9f2f528d0124f270ffeed60f2f5a2ac0e38c483662c4702c9abb5d045e0bd` — static only, runtime unverified.

Copy vs bindings: match. `lobby_tutorial.gd:_show_step/_finish_tutorial` uses A/D/arrows, Space/W/Up, Shift, LMB launch, RMB swing, E elevator/workshop, Esc pause, F skip. Matches supplied bindings. F is hard-coded extra, not remappable.

No syntax/API break. `EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE`, `STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED`, `TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST`, `ResourceLoader.exists`, `set_input_as_handled`, `minf/maxf/absf`, `set_border_width_all` valid. `preload` as type in `lobby.gd:_lobby_tutorial` valid. Requires `MovementController/BallLauncher/RacketController` as global `class_name`, unverified in snapshot.

Issues, actionable:

1. `lobby_tutorial.gd:_layout_panel` fixed `size.y=108.0` with `AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART`: narrow viewport -> 3-line dialogue clipped. Repro: small window, step 0/4 text. Grow vertically or use anchors.
2. `lobby_tutorial.gd:_physics_process` reads `is_on_floor()/velocity` — stale 1 frame if tutorial ticks before `Player` `move_and_slide`. Step 1 `velocity.y<-20.0` + ` _jump_saw_ground` gate needs ground->air->ground; immediate jump on step entry needs 2 jumps. Set `process_physics_priority` after player or latch via signal.
3. Steps 2-4 advance only on accepted `is_dashing`/`launch_accepted`/`swing_started`. Rejected dash/cooldown/invalid aim gives no feedback, looks stuck. Repro: Shift without direction, spam LMB/RMB on cooldown. Add denied hint. F-skip mitigates, not discoverable on gamepad.
4. `lobby_tutorial.gd:start/_build_panel`: never disconnects `launch_accepted/swing_started/viewport.size_changed`, `dismiss_for_travel` hides `_panel` only, leaves full-rect root. Dead node if `LobbyUI` missing. Free/hide root on finish.
5. `lobby.gd:_start_lobby_tutorial_if_needed` gates on `SESSION_INTRO_META` — setter not in snapshot. If intro never sets `intro_completed_this_session`, tutorial never shows. Verify intro path.
6. Elevator preserved: `lobby.gd:_begin_elevator_travel` checks `_can_board` before `dismiss_for_travel()->set_meta`. No workshop `layer 80`/pause `layer 300` regression in diff. Tutorial `MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE` correctly lets clicks through; suspension under modals as specified.
